scope: EXPLORATORY, not registered, GPU shared with other users (CONTENDED=1: no idle wait, overlaps recorded, not replaced); same matrix as Measurement D: cuda5; 1M documents; {ctrl, v3-2, v3-3r} x W {1024, 4096} x k {10, 16, 32, 100, 1000}; 256 threads; 500 calibration queries; batch 1; 3 rotating processes per cell; 3 warm-up + 20 measured rounds; stats set (v3-all stats build, W 1024/4096, k 10/100/1000, untimed); CPU theta reference; not recorded by the team runtime
recording: not recorded by the team runtime; self-recorded manifest

build.flags: nvcc -O3 -lineinfo -arch=sm_89 -std=c++17 (CUDA 12.6), build_variants.sh; stats build -DRBP_V3_STATS=1; v3-3r = v3-3 with crossover argument 1

public_packaging.convention: Team layout on main: raw per-query .csv/.tsv over 1 MB are stored as lossless .gz; full profiler reports, JIT caches and listings too large for Git stay outside Git with their SHA-256; 'artifacts' above still lists every file exactly as produced.
